applicability: The encoder returns only the encoded payload. Omit the framing delimiter.
law: An interior zero separates two code blocks and never appears in encoded payload bytes.
edge_cases: Unequal nonzero bytes before and after the interior zero.

oracle.derivation: Table I assigns code 02 to one payload byte plus an implicit zero. Discard the implicit terminal zero only.
